description: Bangladesh Music Preference Network (BMPN), multi-layer build. Nodes are catalogued artists; edges carry one or more layers. co_billing, personnel and domestic_influence are observational (documented shared bills, shared members, and one act naming another as an influence). influence_homophily is INFERRED -- two acts citing the same global influence are aesthetically adjacent, which proxies for but does not demonstrate shared audience. Combined weight = sum over layers of layer_weight x layer_weight_count.
co_billing_normalisation: Each event contributes 1/(n-1) to every pair on its bill, so a twelve-act festival appearance is worth about a ninth of a two-act gig per neighbour. 'weight' keeps the raw shared-bill count; 'normalised_weight' is what feeds combined_weight.
